posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Blueberries contain anthocyanins that cross the blood-brain barrier.
Studies show they improve memory by 20% in older adults.

posts.headline: Tip
posts.body:
Green tea catechins reduce PSA levels and slow prostate cell division.
3 cups per day shows measurable effects in studies.
posts.cta: Drink green tea for prostate health.
